title: Rabi Crop Planning & Recommendation
summary_lines: 1. Rabi Onion (Bhima Kiran / N-2-4-1) offers strong returns for medium black soils under controlled drip.
2. Gram / Chickpea (Digvijay) provides steady profits with minimal irrigation requirement.
3. Wheat (Samadhan) is an ideal low-risk rotation option if regular canal or well water is secured.
steps: 1. Prepare raised beds with drip lateral spacing before mid-November.
2. Treat seeds with Trichoderma (5g/kg) and Rhizobium culture prior to sowing.
3. Apply well-decomposed organic manure to preserve root zone moisture.
speak_text: Rabi Onion and Gram are your top profitable crop options this season. Ensure seed treatment before sowing and maintain optimal raised beds.
